# Contributing to Aistos

Thank you for your interest in Aistos. Please note the following governance rules before opening an Issue or Pull Request:

1. **Public Mirror:** This repository acts primarily as a public mirror for transparency, security auditing, and bug tracking. 
2. **Feature Requests:** Aistos is developed by a solo maintainer. Unsolicited feature Pull Requests will be automatically closed to maintain the strict <10MB architectural vision.
3. **Bug Fixes & CLA:** If you submit a bug fix via a Pull Request, you must agree to a Contributor License Agreement (CLA). By submitting code, you grant the repository owner the irrevocable right to re-license your contribution under the Proprietary Enterprise License tier.
